files.description: Daily visitor counts at the north entrance (36 rows, rows not in date order, each day at most once, some days missing): day (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD, September-October 2025), visitors (whole number; equal counts are common), remark (short note; about 47% empty). The dates overlap only partly with footfall_south.csv.

Daily visitor counts at the south entrance (36 rows, rows not in date order, each day at most once, some days missing): day (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD, September-October 2025), visitors (whole number; equal counts are common), remark (short note; about 47% empty). The dates overlap only partly with footfall_north.csv.

task_text: For each day in calendar order, give the running total of visitors through both entrances from the first day in the files up to and including that day (an entrance with no count for a day adds nothing). `result` should be a Series indexed by day in calendar order.
intended_computation: For the 47 days that appear in either file, sorted ascending, the cumulative sum of (north count + south count, missing = 0) up to and including each day. Result: Series indexed by day, ascending; the last value is the grand total of both files.

acceptable_variants.notes: values may be whole numbers or decimals.

predicted_direction.reason: The running total follows row order; on 3.x concat(sort=False) leaves the days unsorted, so the cumulative values belong to the wrong days; 2.x sorted the dates.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row R01; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
